lead: `Core\Test::answerHttp` registered twice for one exact URL serves the first answer every time, so a second registration does not script a reconnect.
body: Answers accumulate and the first exact match wins, so an example that reads a stream, "connects again" and expects new events prints the first body twice. Give the second connection its own URL (a query such as `?after=2` is the honest one), and read `nvs agent show 'Core\Test::answerHttp'` for the matching order.
